criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1 and 9 meet most of the bold standard and slide 5 is the best evidence frame though its columns are thin poles. Slides 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 fall toward the 4 descriptor and slide 4's transformer is primitive.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world and a real camera move along one road. The two plan reliefs leave that world, slide 3's orange is a colour no other frame uses, the fence motif barely shows.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral and drawn count traces and was measured. Held at 8 for one company's releases standing in for a filing, slide 5's headline dropping up to, the caption's pronoun and omitted condition, and c22's paraphrase beyond its quote.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the condition are said. The deciding body is never named, no meeting date, no size, no contact, the Batch Zero context left out.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and slide 5 is a well placed turn. Slide 7 steps back to the land after the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, no house rule breaks. An attribution chain on almost every dek, Drawn to illustrate on eight frames, no regional specifics in the copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject and accent. The third lastLight deck in a row, a transformer bay, survey stakes, a shut gate and the squares line repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 2, 6 and 7 so each has one modelled subject owning a third of the frame inside the staged pool, and register frame 3's glow inside the louvres.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat grey card, no neighbour visible, specks for the square and pin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An oblique of about 35 degrees, lit red bed neighbours bleeding three edges, Briscoe's edge a casting cliff, the square a raised block.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No dominant subject on a lit purple mid-tone ground.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The nearest stake at about 1.5 m owning the right third with modelled flagging, the pasture outside the pool near black, the wood line visible into the yard.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat orange slats out of register with the louvres, the left bay cut, dead grass below.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Glow inside the louvres, the tenth at 0.8, all ten bays inside the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A corduroy tray with a hard edge and streaking casts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Ground past three edges, coarser furrows, fix the post casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A centre double post hides the seam and both leaves run off the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back until both hinge posts are inside the frame, one real chain across the latch stiles.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive box with disc-stack bushings and fences that barely register.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop tighter on a modelled radiator bank, shedded porcelain bushings, the pasture fence posts in the pool.
